top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §747.209(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not update their liability insurance information by the renewal date.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies lacked information regarding parent rights.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a dog in the backyard without vaccinations record.

top_violation_types.title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CPR training for the director was completed online.

top_violation_types.title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction (26 TAC §747.1305(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The provider was missing five of the additional training content courses.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by  caregivers.  The  required training topics are 3. administering medication 4.preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction and 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: No diaper changing tables wwere observed in the infant and toddler's rooms.
